api: BigMailer REST API v1 (https://api.bigmailer.io/v1); provider artifact version: v1; OpenAPI 3.0.0
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 80 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official openapi artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion, researched directly against the connector's published OpenAPI/swagger spec (docs.bigmailer.io/llms.txt index + embedded swagger.json). Every read-oriented resource collection is now a stream: the original 5 (brands, users, contacts, lists, fields) plus 9 new brand-scoped/account-scoped resources (connections, message_types, segments, senders, templates, suppression_lists, bulk_campaigns, rss_campaigns, transactional_campaigns, test_campaigns). Every JSON-bodied CRUD mutation on a covered resource is now a writes.json action (create/update/delete for brands, contacts [+upsert], lists, fields, message_types, segments, senders, templates, users) -- capabilities.write flips to true. Campaign SEND/lifecycle actions (send a transactional email, send a test campaign, pause/unpause an RSS campaign) are excluded as destructive_admin (each dispatches real outbound email to real recipients; not a safe reverse-ETL data mutation). Contact-batch upload, suppression-list upload, and sender/bounce-domain DNS verification are excluded as requires_elevated_scope (binary/CSV file upload or external DNS-record verification side effects the declarative dialect has no multipart/verification-polling mechanism for). RSS campaign 'updates' sub-resources (auto-generated per-issue records, not directly authored) are excluded as non_data_endpoint.
